key_idea: Each piece is 3 squares that make a corner. Try to cover each shape with 2 pieces.
steps: Each shape has 6 squares, so it needs 2 corner pieces.
In B, the left and right squares of the top row each touch only the middle top square.
So both of them must be in the same piece as that middle square. That makes a straight row of 3, not a corner.
So B cannot be made. All the other shapes split into 2 corners.

choice_feedback.A: A splits into 2 corners: the top 2 squares with the square under the left one, and the other 3.
choice_feedback.C: C splits into 2 corners: one on the top left step and one on the bottom right step.
choice_feedback.D: D splits into 2 corners: the top 2 squares with the one under the right one, and the other 3.
choice_feedback.E: E splits into 2 corners that fit together into a rectangle.
